Priya (Partnerships): Heads-up — sync with @Kenta on marketplace listing + joint perf announcement. Need perf/W gate and smoke tests before we lock press embargo.

Kenta - HW Partner: Yep, ready. What's the acceptance criteria?

Sam (PerfEng): Short version: 1) end-to-end throughput target >= 700 tokens/s per card on our reference LLM @ seq=2048, 2) steady-state power <= 55W on our rack, 3) 95th p99 latency <= 120ms. If any fail, we fallback to 'low-power variant' in listing.

Elena (Product): Also need A/B artifact for marketplace: perf numbers + a short 200-word note about quantization/compat options.

Kenta - HW Partner: Can do. We'll need the workload spec and a golden config. Send me your run script.

Sam (PerfEng): Dropping a minimal runner snippet — use this for smoke: 
```bash
./run_bench --model redwood-open-1 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --iters 200 --measure-power --telemetry-endpoint https://ingest.redwood.test/bench
```

Sam (PerfEng): Telemetry fields: tags: [partner:kenta, marketplace:preview], metric: power_w, throughput_tok_s, p99_ms. Bench-bot will auto-annotate run id.

Priya (Partnerships): Timeline: partner dry-run by Tue EOD, marketplace smoke Wed morning, press embargo lift Fri noon if green. @Elena can you own the announcement language?

Elena (Product): On it. I'll draft short blurb + FAQ. Need confirm on 'SLA claim' wording — legal ok with 'typical' vs 'guaranteed'?

Alex (DevEx): Also flag: Dedicated customers require a different listing tile. We'll keep marketplace listing neutral and link to dedicated SLA doc.

Kenta - HW Partner: Quick Q — do you need raw power logs or aggregated CSV? We can provide both.

Sam (PerfEng): Both please. Raw logs for kernel devs, CSV for the doc. Also include kernel versions and nv driver revisions.

Priya (Partnerships): Sweet. I'll post a short checklist in the partner workspace. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: Bench run queued: id=BR-1746004321-01 status=queued

Kenta - HW Partner: Copy that, starting dry-run today. Ping if any regression.

Priya (Partnerships): Thanks all — will loop in legal and marketing after dry-run results.
